title: host.update_plugins (platform → host)
description: Installs a Ready Up bundle with Ready Up's install.sh: bundle default → essentials, skins → full. Source: the bundle configured on the host (csm agent config readyup_bundle: a zip or https URL, {version}/{bundle} substituted), else the GitHub release `version` (or the latest). No such release: host.result failed / no_release; nothing is installed. Running targets are stopped, installed and started again. Disruptive (gated like host.update_game). Long job: host.progress. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).

accept_license.description: csm addition: the Ready Up license use the platform's admin accepted (Settings > License). csm saves it as the host's answer when the host has none of its own (an operator's `csm plugins license` or AT_ACCEPT_LICENSE always wins), so unattended Ready Up installs can run.
